title: Rediscovering The Priority of Law For Kingdom Living Part 5
paragraphs: When you start teaching about law, people get nervous. But I want to say upfront that when I use the word law, I am not talking about religious traditions. We will explain this very clearly in this series. I am talking about laws that never change, planted in God’s creation and in His spiritual structure, and they never change. Most of the laws that have put humans in slavery were made by humans. I am not referring to those religious laws based on legalism, and we will explain that in this series.

But it is important for me to say this upfront because sometimes we become a little nervous when we are free from something, and we feel as if we are going back to it. You can never abandon God's laws. You can leave human laws. So I would like to start by reminding us of a few things. Write this down. Every nation in the world is built on law. It is impossible for a state to exist without law. Why did I make this statement? Because the Kingdom of God is not a religion. It is a country.

It is called the Kingdom of Heaven. God established the Kingdom of Heaven as the first invisible nation in existence. The land is called the sky. The government was founded by Jehovah. It is a real and effective government. Secondly, nations are built on law, but they are also sustained by law. When laws break down, the state collapses. For this reason, every nation, if it is a civil society, is considered a nation that respects the law. Where there is no law, there can be no civilization.

Third, the quality of life in a nation depends on and is determined by the people’s adherence to the laws. National life is protected by law. What prevents people from legally entering your home and taking your belongings? The law does that. What prevents you from colliding with another car when you stop at a stop sign? Because there is a law that regulates that intersection. What makes the bank return your money when you go to withdraw it if you have deposited it?

There is a law that requires them to hand over what you put there. In other words, laws protect society. Fourth, all societies must abide by the law. If we do not obey the laws, we will not have social relationships. All our relationships within the country are monitored and regulated by law. That is why when you get married, you must obtain a legal document to consecrate and legitimize your union. They are giving you a license to get married. They give you a license to drive a car.

They give you a license to build a house. In other words, everything must be legal if we want society to succeed. Fifth, society is produced and created by law. This is important because when we talk about the Kingdom of Heaven, it is a community. You cannot live by your own rules within a society. What makes a society a society is what they call social norms. The word customs means what is natural for this society to comply with. There are certain rules in our culture that we have come to regard as our customs.

We do not do certain things or break certain promises because of those customs. It is the laws that create that society. I mentioned in a previous session that professions are also communities. There is a community of lawyers. Why? There are certain laws that lawyers must abide by. Then there is the medical profession. They have a community of medical practitioners. Why? They serve certain types of laws that they abide by. In other words, any group becomes a society if it is subject to laws that it adheres to.

Now, this leads me to my next point. How important is the law? There are people who know that when Jesus came to Earth, he abolished the law. And that he came to Earth to destroy the law. I think we should be careful. When we use terminology, let's make sure the concepts are accurate. When Jesus came to Earth 2000 years ago, he was born into a very religious culture. The primary religion of the culture in which he was born was Judaism.

Judaism was in fact a 4,000-year evolution of a structure of rituals that became so difficult that even those who devised it could not adhere to it. In fact, the religious leaders of his time were called legalists or teachers of the law. The question is, which law? The two main groups were the Pharisees and the Sadducees. There were many others, but the two main groups of religious leaders in his time were the Pharisees and the Sadducees. The Pharisees and Sadducees were very powerful.

The Pharisees were more religious. The Sadducees were more attached to the legal form. They were more political. They all took the Law of Moses and added their own laws to it over the course of 4000 years. They developed a set of laws which they called the traditions of the elders. God knows very little about these laws, but they claimed to present them in God’s name. In fact, the total eventually amounted to 669 laws. Write that down. Can you imagine having to obey 669 laws every day?

That was a very heavy burden on the people. You couldn't even remember what you were disobeying. Therefore, when Christ came, he could not join them. He never became a Pharisee. He never became a Sadducee because they were Sadducees. But he never became part of them, because what he meant was not what they meant. They produced a religion that had no connection to the Kingdom of God.

That is why, when he began to preach, he reintroduced the Kingdom of God, and they felt offended because the Kingdom of God always challenges religion. He constantly challenges the structures that control people. It will also destroy injustice. Parents can be very unfair. Thus we have two different laws. Let us read what Jesus says when he presents himself. Because he restored the primacy of the law. He did not destroy the law. In fact, he put the law back where it fell from.

Law is the foundation inherent in creation. As we go through this conference and this series, I will show you that God has laws designed to ensure your success. I tell you that most of our failures are simply the result of disobeying or ignoring God’s laws. It is inherent in creation. The other point is that law is the glue that holds the universe together. We all agree that out of 500 million galaxies, these planets do not collide.

How can 500 million galaxies containing trillions of planets remain in their orbits and revolve around their suns with such precision and never collide? There is a system, and a law. Even our solar system, where the Earth we live on is located, consists of nine planets and one sun, and they have been orbiting the sun for millions of years without colliding. There are laws built into that structure that keep it in order. Let everyone say that law and order go hand in hand. The law will always produce order.

Therefore, wherever there is disorder, know that there is a violation of some law. Now, the third point here is that everything exists according to law. Plants follow the laws. You take a seed, you put it in the soil, a little moisture, and you obey the law. What is happening? A tree grows. In other words, the laws are already incorporated. God does not make trees grow. He simply put a law in the seed. When you obey the laws of the seed, the result is natural.

Success is indeed expected if you understand the priority of the law. This leads me to my next point. Everything exists based on a law and exists to fulfill a law. This includes you and me. We were not born to live randomly. Do you know that? When I read books written by some of the great thinkers of meditation, people like Buddha, Confucius, Maharaj, and all those Eastern mystics. Do you know what they really focus on? simply. They focus on natural laws.

In other words, even scientists study God’s laws and build science on these laws, because the laws are inherent. It is inherent in the very essence of things. I think the problem that may arise with most of these mystical teachers is that they often make the law itself into a god. As you know, there's a saying that if you have a good, working watch, you set it and it works. There was a watchmaker somewhere. So, don't get caught up in how amazing the watch works, how deep it is, or how complex it is.

Just remember that there is a maker somewhere. Do not make the clock the focus of worship. Humanists, for example, have made creation the focus of their worship. They themselves have become the standard of what is right and what is good. This is serious, because, you know, someone sent me an email that day that was really good. They said there was a real trial in Florida where an atheist appeared in court demanding that a holiday be designated for atheists.

Christians have a holiday for Christmas, and Muslims have a holiday for Ramadan. They said they wanted a holiday for atheists, that we don't treat them well, we don't respect them, and they need their own holiday. He appeared before the court and presented his full argument to the judge. When he finished, the judge said, "Considering your presentation and arguments, I believe you are right that you need a vacation."

"And I would like to say, as the judge responsible for this community, that I have found your holiday; you already have one." The man said, "We have one? Who are we celebrating?" He said, " Everyone is celebrating your holiday." He said, "What is my holiday?" He said: "April Fool's Day." The man was confused and bewildered. He said, " April Fool's Day, how can that be a holiday?" The judge turned to the Bible and said, " The Lord says, 'The fool says in his heart, "There is no God."'"

And you have a day that is celebrated all over the world. Do not make the clock a god. People worship Mother Earth. There is no Mother Earth. The earth is a product of God's creation. The sun is simply a mass of gases, dense gases that give off tremendous nuclear light. Do not worship the sun. You are talking about the sun god. No, that's the god of gases. In other words, do not confuse creation with the Creator. He has established laws in His creation. Obey those laws and life will be written for you.

Disobey it and you will destroy yourself. Now, please write this down. This is extremely important. When 5. Again, please read carefully. I call this the priority of the law. In Matthew chapter 5, Jesus' first public ministry appears. He is 30 years old, leaves the desert where he spent 40 days, introduces himself to the whole world and makes an announcement. See chapter 4, verse 17, where he comes out of the desert. He was there for 40 days fasting and praying. He dealt with his body. He dealt with his mind.

Overcome many of these experiences that we face every day. He defeated them all. Then verse 17 of Matthew 4 says: From that time onward, Jesus began to preach, saying: Repent, for what? The kingdom of heaven has drawn near. That's what it means. The Kingdom is not a religion. It is a country. So he returned to Earth to reintroduce God’s planet to the Kingdom of Heaven. He says: Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand. Write the word "repent" again. The word repentance is not a religious word.

The word repentance comes from psychology. It's a psychological term. It means changing your mental state. It means changing the way you have been trained to think. It means changing your mindset. To completely change your thinking patterns, the way you have been trained to think. Well, that makes sense because how does a man think? So, is it in his subconscious? So, he says, "Change the way you've been trained to think because another nation has returned to the planet.

Earth is actually one planet with two cultures on it. The culture of the kingdom of darkness and the kingdom of light." It is very clear in the Bible. Therefore, we are talking about culture. We are talking about a country. Oh, can I say it like that? He is talking about colonizing the land again or recolonizing the land. Colonialism is simply the influence of one country's culture on a foreign territory. Christ brought the culture of heaven back to earth. This announcement is very clear.

Let everyone say the word " state". nation. What is a state? A nation. What is a nation built upon? Laws. Now watch him. He meets with these religious people. He grew up with them for 30 years and never joined them. Why? He said, "These people are crazy. They have made their laws more important than the word of God." He said that in Matthew 15, we will read that in a little while. They have become so afflicted with their own laws that they have forgotten God. This is rigid legitimacy.

Rigid legalism is when you begin to worship the law more than you worship God. We have done that here in the Bahamas and in the Caribbean. We are professionals in law-based worship. I remember when I was growing up in the Bahamas, and please don't take it personally, but as you know, wearing hats was a religious matter. May I touch on this for a moment? I will address it anyway. They used to say that if you didn't cover your head, God wouldn't hear you.

So, women had to walk around, you know, and believe me, I think the people who created this law were the ones who were selling hats. Well, if you study the Book of Ephesians, it talks about the religion of the Ephesians, those who worshipped the religion of the Ephesians, which was a god of lust and a god of frivolity. When Paul came to that city, he made all those people save, and they stopped buying all those things. So the people attacked Paul and imprisoned him. They said it disrupted our business.

That's why they say women should wear hats. She was raised in the Baptist Church. Hmm. The Pentecostal Church. Hmm. Right here. The women wore hats on their heads. You couldn't stand in the church without wearing a hat. You could have read the Bible. Are you crazy? Your head should be covered. And all those profound things they were talking about. We were afraid for women to go anywhere without hats. And I found out where they got that from.

They brought it from the Book of Corinth, you know, when Paul says that a woman should not worship with her head uncovered. Of course, if you read the entire chapter. He wasn't talking about hats. He was talking about a married woman who is under the protection of her husband. But let's put that aside. Paul then went on to explain some other matters relating to poetry.

He says that women should let their hair grow, and men should cut their hair; Because, he says, nature proves that women have natural glands that secrete certain types of oils that keep long hair healthy, while men do not have the same hormone levels to produce those oils. Therefore, he says that it is well known that if a man has short hair, it is easier to take care of it. It was a biological science discussion conducted by Paul. We are the ones who turned it into a religious debate.

Also, Paul then began to explain why women should cover their heads in the city where he was, Corinth. That was not a national doctrine. In fact, the Corinthians wrote a letter to Paul and began to make complaints. You will find a complaint in the book. He says, "Look," he says, "We have problems in Corinth. The women are accustomed to certain customs because of their previous lives, and so on." Paul said, "Let me write this letter in response to them." He wrote his letter in response to these people.

Corinth was the capital of the worship of "Eros". In fact, the word Corinth means corrupt. Never name your house, your child, or Corinth. It means corrupt. It is a name given to the city by the Romans. The Romans themselves were already corrupt. If they call a city corrupt, that is double corruption. They were extremely corrupt. They named the city Corruption. Is everyone still with me? Good. Therefore, the books of the Bible are called " First and Second Corinthians" (the two epistles of corruption).

This is the city that Paul went to. The Apostle Paul preached the Gospel there, and the city was the capital of the worship of Eros. Eros is the goddess of sex. The largest temple to Eros was in Corinth. His remains are still there today. When my wife and I went to Greece, to the region where Paul was, we saw these temples. It's still there. In those temples, they practiced the worship of the goddess Eros. They have that huge statue of a naked woman there.

They had rows of columns, a huge temple, the largest in the entire Roman Empire. On the sides of the temple were marble slabs the size of a human being. These tablets were used to enable people to worship the goddess Eros by having sex inside the temple. Their method of worshipping the god "Ares" was by offering fruits, sacrifices, and wine, and then bringing someone to have sex on the altar, and thus they would obtain the protection and fertility of the goddess "Eros". It was a center for sexual practices.

It was a religion, a pagan religion. It is clear that what arose around that entire place were brothels, where people were available for purposes of worship. Do you understand? Go back. Check it out online. These things are available on the internet. Their job was to make themselves available to help you in worship. That is why in the letter to the Corinthians, you find Paul talking about homosexuality and lesbianism, because that was a big business around the temple.

You are traveling from Egypt and want to stop to worship; you need to find someone to worship with. So, give me $50, and let's go worship. Therefore, we find prostitution mentioned in the Epistle to the Corinthians because it was the biggest business in the city of Corinth. For this reason, the Romans called Corinth the center of corruption. Now, the way they were identifying prostitutes is interesting. In their culture, the male prostitute would grow his hair long. That's how you got to know him.

As for the female prostitute, she would cut her hair short. She was cutting her hair completely. So, you can tell who is available just by looking at them, at their appearance. That's how it was. So when you went to Corinth, if you saw a man with long hair, you knew he was a prostitute, whether male or female, he practiced both. Homosexuality was therefore very widespread in Corinth. If you see a woman with short hair adorned with all kinds of jewelry, that woman is a prostitute.

This can include both sides, lesbian or heterosexual relationships. In other words, this was a huge business. They actually discovered that around the temple there were small huts where they lived close to the temple to be available for work. Paul went there and preached the kingdom of God, and the people accepted the word and the church was born in Corinth, and most of those who were saved were former prostitutes. I am trying to show you how idolatry corrupts everything. And so these people were saved.

They abandoned their old way of life and began to meet in church houses, small houses around the place where they came to communion. Many of them would go to church, and the woman would still have short hair because it hadn't grown back yet since she had been saved. They would go to church, and men or even lesbians would come and say, " Look, I want to do business." They would say, "I don't do that anymore." They say, "But look at yourself." "You look like you're doing that," and that became a problem.

Then there were men who grew their hair long and put rings in their noses and things like that, and this was very common in those days. The man or woman would say, "I need you to come and worship with me," and the man would say, "No, I have changed my life; I follow Jesus Christ now."

It became such a big problem that church leaders wrote a letter to Paul and said, "Look, we are having trouble with these people who are trying to stay pure, trying to stay upright, because they are being pressured by those who come to worship." Paul wrote this. Paul says: “ Tell the women to cover their heads until their hair grows, for a woman’s hair is her glory. Tell the men to cut their hair. Tell the women to take off all those jewels, for they are part of the distinguishing marks of a prostitute.

Tell them to dress modestly.” This means take off all those things. Paul was not making laws for the church. He was correcting a problem, excuse me, a prostitution problem. Is everyone with me? This is important. So we went along saying that Paul said everyone in the Bahamas should wear hats. If Paul came to some churches today, he would think everyone was a prostitute. They made it a religious law. Paul says: "A woman's hair is her glory." Take off your hat. Let us see your glory.

Now, if you like hats, that's fine. My wife wears hats from time to time, but it's for style, not for religious reasons. You can wear your bracelets and jewelry, but that's not a sign that you're available. You are not available. Go to some of the red-light districts and you'll know who's available. They wear what they call it, I don't know what they call those things. No, they are not short ( mini) skirts. Instead, they wear something shorter. Higher than short.

You know, you can tell them by those high heels and all those things they wear. You could say they are available. This means that if you come to church like this, we will start to question you. In other words, anything that the culture deems questionable, you should modify in your life. If you are married, do not display your charms. Why? It's for your husband, girl. And if you are single, do not display your charms. Why? That's for your future husband. You are not for sale. I hope so.

Here we have laws made by people, not laws from God. Sometimes Paul even warned them. He used to say, "Now what I am telling you is not from God. This is my personal opinion." He says, " So, we are not here to impose laws made by humans on you, but at the same time, the Kingdom of God is a country and it has laws. And like any country, you have to obey the laws to live in that society." Let 's read the words of Jesus.

On the opposite page, in Matthew chapter five, Jesus said these words: “Do not think that I have come to abolish the law.” Now, why is he saying this? Because he was preaching the message of the Kingdom, he knew that the Pharisees, Sadducees, and religious leaders would attack him over the issue of the Law. Or they will say, " Oh, are you telling us that we can live in disregard and disobedience to God?"

Indeed, they often brought up the story of Moses and said, "The laws of Moses, are you telling people to break the laws of Moses?" " So he began by saying, "First, let me explain." Do not think that I came to abolish the law. "And this was the problem with the 20th-century church. We went to the opposite extreme, clinging to grace to the point of lawlessness. We became so obsessed with God's forgiveness that we used it to break God's laws. ' Oh, I'll be forgiven tomorrow, so I'll sin now.' That's what we say.

'Oh, I can always go to God after doing this, and He'll forgive me because He has to forgive me because He promised.' See, and so we use that grace to break God's law. Christ says, 'Look, let's make this clear.'" " By the way, this is the beginning of his ministry. He begins by saying, 'Look, the kingdom of God is here, and he did not come to destroy the law.'" It is based on law. Actually, read the rest of the verse with me. Let's read it together. Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets.

The word “ prophets” here, we can deal with it in a little while, but it is important because the prophets are simply those who repeated the law. God established the law. And the prophets continued to repeat it. I did not come to destroy the Law, nor those who repeated it. But what did you come for? Rather, I came to fulfill the law. I tell you the truth. Until heaven and earth pass away, not one letter, not one stroke of a pen, will pass away from the Law until everything is accomplished. Don't assume.

Pay attention. Why does he have to say that? Because he knows what you are thinking. I am free. free. He says, “Yes, you are free, but not from the Law. You are free from the burden of trying to please God by keeping the rituals. You are free from that. You are free from trying to impress God with all your holy life and all, you know, your offerings and sacrifices. You are free from that. I have become the Lamb. You don’t need to do that anymore. You are free from that.

But you are not free from keeping God’s commandments. Let’s take it a step further. Don’t assume. Say it with me. Write this down, please. What does he mean by ‘Don’t assume ’? I’ve done some research for you. The Hebrew word means ‘Don’t think.’ It also means ‘Don’t imagine.’ He says, ‘ Get that out of your heads. Don’t dream that I came to abolish the Law. Don’t even think about it.’ He says, ‘We’ve literally made it into a doctrine. I am free from the Law. I am under grace. We’ve made it into a doctrine.

We actually call it the doctrine of grace.’ What are you telling God? He says, ‘Look, don’t assume that I came to abolish the Law. Don’t suggest to anyone that the Law has That's it. To live in God's kingdom and expect God's promises to be fulfilled, you must also obey the laws of God's promises. Listen to me, friends. Even in your own country, you can't just live however you please. Our countries— Jamaica, Barbados, St. Thomas and Kitts, Grenada, Guyana, America, Canada, and England—each have a constitution.

And now, within that constitution are promises to the citizen. The constitution is, in fact, the aspirations of the people put into a document, and that document contains all the promises made to the citizens, which represent their rights. Now, in order to obtain your rights, the constitution also sets out the laws by which the citizen will live. So, the citizen can claim the promises set forth in their constitution.

In other words, the condition for receiving what the constitution promises is that you be a law-abiding citizen. If you kill someone in the Bahamas, we remove you from society and put you in a small cell. Why? Because you can no longer live in an environment where you can enjoy the promises of our constitution. Are you trying to tell me that God is worse than us? Is God Leaning on his promises? You need to go back and read his constitution. One of God's favorite words. Write this down. The word "if."

His favorite word is: "If you do this," "If you do that," "If you obey me," "If you keep," "If then I will," " Then I will." Mind you. " If" comes before "Then." "God, pay my rent." God says, "Okay, if you pay your tithes." Now, do you see where you're going again? You're ruining the whole conversation. In other words, we want promises without commitment to principles. That's what we're talking about here. Christ says, "Don't think that I came to abolish God's laws. I am God, and I made the laws."

Another meaning is, "Don't even think about it." It means, "Don't let the thought cross your minds that I came to destroy the law. Get that thought out of your heads." He says it also means, "I didn't come to nullify." Now, the word "nullify" means to destroy, or to set aside, or to render ineffective, or to cancel, or to eradicate. I came to abolish the law, or eradicate it, or render it invalid, or even to repeal or set it aside. I came to do the opposite. What did he come to do?

He says: I came to complete the law. I wanted to put these two things in here before we leave today. Write this down. The law and the prophets. I did the research for you. That's why I'm the teacher. Just write this down. This is important because when you start telling your children this around the dinner table, you have to explain it to them. That's why you take notes. You have to be responsible for the individuals in your home to help them succeed. If you want to succeed, my son, you have to keep God's laws.

Another word for law is the Word. The Word of God. What is the law? The law is the inherent commandments, principles, standards, and regulations established by the Creator. A statement of a very important document. The law is the original commandments, the original principles, and standards, inherent and regulating the product, established by the Creator. The car in the parking lot that you brought here is subject to exactly this same principle. Your car operates according to the law called unleaded gasoline.

You didn't decide that. Who did? The company? The manufacturer that made the car, and this system is built into the car. So your opinion doesn't affect that law. If you like orange juice or apple juice and prefer to put it in your car, the law does n't respect that. In fact, the car will break down because it's not regulated by orange juice. It's regulated by unleaded gasoline. Not just any gasoline, but unleaded.

If you put regular gasoline in your car, it will affect the engine because there are certain components in regular gasoline that will have a negative effect on the combustion chamber, and you'll find your car has some problems due to using the wrong type of gasoline. That's why they sometimes write right on the fuel filler neck, "Use only unleaded gasoline," because the regulation of that car is controlled by the law set by the manufacturer. God is smarter than Ford. He is wiser than Mitsubishi.

He knows His creation. Actually, can I give you something to do? Go home today and get some alcohol. Exactly. Good alcohol, pure alcohol, expensive alcohol, and pour it on the plant in your house. It's like water. Just pour it on the plant. You don't need to kill that plant. Plants don't It needs alcohol. It regulates what? Water. So, your personal opinion might destroy the plant. Do you know what kills us? Our personal preferences. I'd rather live with someone without being married. God says, "Okay, no problem."

"I prefer to choose my own lifestyle." God says, "Okay, no problem." "I don't need to kill you." He is the one who kills you. One thing in the law is that it exonerates the Creator. God doesn't kill. We destroy ourselves. Your lungs are the most beautiful instrument in your body. They are designed to inhale pure oxygen. Then the alveolar cells extract the oxygen from the air and release carbon dioxide, and then the lungs do something. The muscles move and expel the carbon dioxide, which is a poison.

What a beautiful instrument your lungs are. They take in, extract, and expel waste. They inhale good oxygen and expel toxic carbon dioxide. God created that organ to do that. And here you are, inhaling a carcinogenic cigarette. Your lungs weren't designed to extract nicotine and carcinogens from the air. They can't handle the toxins in that cigarette. So they get stuck in the lung cells and start burning them, and you end up with what they call lung poisoning. Your lungs turn black.

That's why God says, "Let everything that has breath praise the Lord." You can't. Praise be to Him. You, you, you have broken the law. Your lungs were not made for nicotine. Who is killing you? You are killing yourself. Some of the most talented people in the Bahamas died today from cancer. We have lost them. We have lost their gifts. We have lost their talents because of a tobacco leaf. It regulates life. That is what laws do. The second point is the prophets.

He said, "I did not come to abolish the Law or the Prophets." The prophets are the individuals whom God chose to proclaim, teach, and exalt God's laws and their proclamation. That is what the prophets do. The prophets do not invent the law. They simply repeat it. If you read the prophets of the Old Testament, they always said, " The word of the Lord came to me." The Word of the Lord.” In other words, the law has returned to me to remind a nation that it is going down the wrong path.

The prophecy says, “Well, if you continue down this path against God’s law, a national disaster will occur.” That’s what prophets do. They don’t invent information. They repeat information. That’s why you shouldn’t believe any prophet who makes up things that aren’t in God’s Word. People say, “You know, the Lord told me you should give me $100 and He’ll bless you.” Hold on a minute, brother. We have prophets going around selling things. We have to be careful. And some of you are acting strangely.

Not all of you, but some of you are acting strangely and following these groups of prophets, gathering information from dubious people. Let me say something very simple. The more you study God’s Word, the less you need prophets in your life. Don’t go around gathering people’s opinions about you. That’s right. If you become spiritually mature, you won’t need a prophet to prophesy to you. And if they do prophesy to you, if they are true prophets, they will never tell you anything new.

They They simply remind you of what you heard from God a long time ago. That is the true prophet. I remember in the Book of Acts, when Paul went to visit a city, there was a man named Agabus who had two daughters, and they were meeting with Paul. God had already told Paul when he fell from his horse, saying, “See, you will go before Caesar and be tried for me, and you will testify for me before the king.” Well, God told him this when he fell from his horse.

Ten years later, Paul was in the city, and two young women in the church stood up and began prophesying before Paul. They tied his hands and said, “Thus says the Lord.” When you go to Rome, they will put you in chains and you will speak before the king.” Paul said, “Thank you very much.” I already know that. Read the Bible. Paul says, "You are not telling me anything new." Sometimes people want to be impressed. They come to me. I had a dream last night. The Lord said, " You will face difficulties, Pastor M."
